title: Boethius, In Categorias Aristotelis libri IV — Commentary on Aristotle's Categories; Боэций, «Комментарий к Категориям Аристотеля». Proposed unit: Book I
author: Anicius Manlius Severinus Boethius
edition: Migne PL 64 (public domain); no modern critical edition found
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia 'Боэций' lists Russian versions only of the Consolatio, the Porphyry commentary and the tractates (1990), and De musica (2012)
en_evidence: Not in the SEP translation list; the Ancient Commentators on Aristotle series has only the De interpretatione volumes (2010, 2011, 1998)
value: First Latin commentary on the Categories and a channel for Porphyry's lost exegesis. Foundational for the medieval logica vetus and Latin ontological terms (substantia, accidens). For historians of philosophy and logic
ai_feasibility: high — regular argumentation; terms must be mapped to the Greek
